your_games.title: Phantom Blade Zero reviews are in, and critics love its combat
your_games.body: S-GAME's action RPG lands this week, and early reviews are glowing. Push Square gives it 9/10 and calls it one of the generation's greatest action experiences, praising a combat system where normal attacks, dodges and parries don't drain stamina, so you're free to go wild. The main gripe is the storytelling, with lots of flashbacks and tedious collectibles. VGC scores it 4/5 and says it's a damn good action game that shouldn't be ignored. It unlocks on PS5 and PC on 29 Oct (about 04:00 SAST) for $59.99.

your_games.title: Darkest Dungeon II gets a Switch 2 Edition, with a cheap upgrade
your_games.body: Red Hook's roguelike RPG is out now on Switch 2 for $42.98 / £36.24, or $2.99 / £2.24 to upgrade if you own the Switch version. You get better frame rates, Joy-Con 2 mouse support and new combat and driving speed settings. Nintendo Life notes the base game is on sale in some regions, so buying that plus the upgrade can work out cheaper.

your_games.title: Tomb Raider turns 30 with a new Legacy of Atlantis trailer
your_games.body: Amazon Games, Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog marked the series' 30th anniversary with a fresh teaser for Legacy of Atlantis, the reimagining of the original game. It's due on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC on 12 Feb 2027. Aspyr also put out a celebration trailer, and several Tomb Raider games are on sale on Switch, including Shadow of the Tomb Raider, which shadow-dropped on Switch 2 last week.

your_games.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2's 10th-anniversary update lands 27 Oct
your_games.body: Bandai Namco's free update adds login bonuses, special costumes and a Gallery of Time refresh, and the "Final Festival" event starts on 30 Oct with 25 times the usual Star Coins and rare items returning. Earning the event's new Gi or commemorative medal will unlock bonus items in Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 when it arrives in 2027, if you link your Bandai Namco ID.

your_games.title: Shenmue 3 Enhanced slips to early 2027
your_games.body: Publisher ININ confirmed in a newsletter that the enhanced re-release, which adds an optional stamina system and a revamped camera, won't make its 2026 window. It says development is making great progress and it's now aiming for early 2027.

industry.title: PS5 was the only console to grow in US sales in September
industry.body: Push Square, citing Circana data, says PS5 unit sales rose 22% year on year in September, beating the Switch 2 in units, while Xbox sales fell 27%. Thanks to price rises, PS5 dollar sales were up 43%, with an average selling price of $646, despite a rough month of online backlash for Sony.

industry.title: Sony's anti-jailbreak firmware push draws criticism
industry.body: Sony has sped up PS5 firmware updates to fight hacks, and some newer physical games need the latest firmware to play, which has stirred up anger on social media. Push Square points out this has been normal since the PS3 era, and discs can usually install the update themselves.

industry.title: Sonic X Shadow Generations passes three million sales
industry.body: Sega announced that total worldwide sales of the game have now topped three million units.
